meta.title: Grid Modes
meta.description: Compare Standard Grid, Activity Boards, and Core-Fringe communication models in Loquor AAC.

hero.title: Grid Modes
hero.description: Loquor AAC supports three grid models so teams can match communication structure to user context.

modes.name: Standard Grid
modes.summary: Classic category and subcategory browsing with predictable symbol locations.
modes.details: Works with favourites and progression while preserving core motor-planning patterns.

modes.name: Activity Boards
modes.summary: Board-based navigation for routines like meals, school, and therapy sessions.
modes.details: Supports board links, functional navigation cells, and in-place edit mode workflows.

modes.name: Core-Fringe
modes.summary: Pinned core words remain stable while fringe pages change by context.
modes.details: Includes page trees, slot management, progressive vocabulary locking, and per-grid-size layout handling.
includes: Pinned core slots across all pages
Nested page navigation with auto Home/Back buttons
